beforeCommand:
set -eu
# Some hosts/app-update flows can clobber Postgres ownership while the stack is running
# (e.g., blanket chown of the app state dir). Watch for it and self-heal.
pg_dir="/data/pool/postgres"
check_ui_dir() {
  dir="$$1"
  label="$$2"
  mode="$${3:-recursive}"
  if [ -d "$$dir" ]; then
    uid="$$(stat -c '%u' "$$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
    gid="$$(stat -c '%g' "$$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
    if [ "$$uid" != "1000" ] || [ "$$gid" != "1000" ]; then
      echo "[axedgb] Fixing $$label ownership (1000:1000)"
      if [ "$$mode" = "top" ]; then
        chown 1000:1000 "$$dir" 2>/dev/null || true
      else
        chown -R 1000:1000 "$$dir" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  fi
}
while true; do
  if [ -d "$$pg_dir" ]; then
    uid="$$(stat -c '%u' "$$pg_dir" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
    gid="$$(stat -c '%g' "$$pg_dir" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
    if [ "$$uid" != "70" ] || [ "$$gid" != "70" ]; then
      echo "[axedgb] Fixing Postgres datadir ownership (70:70)"
      chown -R 70:70 "$$pg_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
      chmod 700 "$$pg_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  check_ui_dir /data/node "node dir" top
  check_ui_dir /data/pool/config "pool config dir"
  check_ui_dir /data/ui/state "UI state dir"
  check_ui_dir /data/templates "templates dir"
  sleep 5
done
scope: Only the stateless permission repair helper supervision changes. Existing directory ownership tests, UID/GID roles, chmod rules, node-top-only behavior, UI, images, mining policy and application/chain state remain unchanged.
interruption: TERM/INT signals and reaps only the tracked active chown/chmod/sleep. Recursive repair can be partial; BusyBox depth-first chown updates the top directory last, retaining the existing wrong-owner retry condition until recursive completion. Actual pinned-image interruption and restart must verify this; no completion markers are created.
